overview.description: The Corgi U.S. Utilities 2x Daily ETF (XLUX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in utilities equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of the Utilities Select Sector SPDR ETF (Ticker: XLU), which provides exposure to US utilities stocks. XLUX was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
